leaking.speaker: narrator
leaking.text: The main reclamation pump shudders on every stroke. A thread of water creeps from the housing where a seal ought to be, freezing into a grey tongue on the deck.

fit.speaker: narrator
fit.text: Twenty minutes of skinned knuckles. The old seal comes away in three pieces; the new one seats with a click you feel through the wrench. The pump's stutter smooths out into a steady pulse.

fixed.speaker: narrator
fixed.text: The pump runs with a steady, unhurried pulse. The deck beneath it is dry.
